connector.name: IntentWake Audience Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Enrich first-party lists with live intent, activity, and inbox signals for marketing and outreach.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.intentwake.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.intentwake, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by an IntentWake connection token or scoped API key.

env.name: INTENTWAKE_CONNECTION_TOKEN
env.description: IntentWake connection token or scoped API key.

env.name: INTENTWAKE_ALLOWED_ROOTS
env.description: Approved absolute local roots separated by the operating-system path delimiter.
